name: Beefeater Burrough's Reserve
production: One-shot distillation in James Burrough's copper Still Number 12 (268 L)
Rested in oak casks for 'weeks rather than years'
Edition 1: ex-Jean de Lillet casks; Edition 2: red and white Bordeaux casks
history: 2013 | Announced April 2013; launched Spain June, UK late June, US October 2013
2016 | Second edition released (red and white Bordeaux casks)
notes: Created by master distiller Desmond Payne; named after founder James Burrough. Tasting notes from Difford's (industry), first edition. Botanicals not individually listed.
